'''Broken Scar''' was an [[Esh-kha]] living in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He had a group of followers, one of whom was [[Hallow Voice]], an Esh-kha who held unusually pacifistic views, unlike the rest of his species. Eventually Hallow Voice was captured by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and imprisoned in stasis on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for thousands of years until his release around [[3641 BBY]], after which he still honored the name of Broken Scar.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Broken Scar is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by Hallow Voice during the Consular storyline.
